name: PB Bulk Product Editor for WooCommerce
author: Pluginbrew

sections.installation:
1. Upload the pluginbrew-bulk-product-editor-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Products > Product Bulk Editor to start managing your catalog.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support Variable Products?

It currently lists individual product rows. For variable products, it works best for main product attributes, but future updates will focus on enhanced variation control.

How many products can I edit at once?

You can edit as many products as are displayed on the page (default is 20). Simply switch pages to edit more.

Is it compatible with other WooCommerce plugins?

Yes, it uses standard WooCommerce CRUD data methods, ensuring maximum compatibility and data integrity.
sections.description:
Best WooCommerce Bulk Product Editor plugin to quickly edit prices, stock, SKU, and product data in a spreadsheet-like interface.
Save time with fast inline bulk editing inside your WordPress dashboard.

🚀 Bulk Edit WooCommerce Products Faster Than Ever

Managing WooCommerce products one by one is slow and inefficient.

PB Bulk Product Editor for WooCommerce is a powerful WooCommerce bulk edit plugin that allows you to edit WooCommerce products in bulk using a fast, spreadsheet-style interface.

Update prices, stock, SKUs, product details, and more — all in one place without opening multiple product pages.

No CSV import/export. No page reloads. Just fast, real-time bulk editing.

🌟 Key Features – WooCommerce Bulk Editing Made Easy

  • 📊 Spreadsheet Editor for WooCommerce
    Edit products in a grid view similar to Excel or Google Sheets.

  • 💰 Bulk Edit Product Prices
    Update regular price, sale price, and discounts for multiple products at once.

  • 📦 Bulk Stock Management
    Quickly update stock quantity, stock status, backorders, and inventory settings.

  • 🏷️ Edit Product Details in Bulk
    Modify SKUs, product titles, weight, dimensions, and more.

  • 🚚 Bulk Update Shipping & Tax Settings
    Assign shipping classes, tax status, and tax classes easily.

  • 👁️ Control Product Visibility
    Change catalog visibility, featured status, and product status in bulk.

  • 🔍 Advanced Product Search & Filters
    Find products by ID, SKU, or name instantly.

  • ⚡ Instant AJAX Save
    Save all changes without page reloads for faster workflow.

  • 📈 Handles Large WooCommerce Stores
    Pagination ensures smooth editing even with thousands of products.

  • 🔒 Secure & Native WooCommerce Integration
    Built using WooCommerce CRUD for safe and reliable updates.

🎯 Use Cases – Why You Need a WooCommerce Bulk Editor

  • Bulk update product prices for sales and promotions
  • Mass stock updates after inventory restock
  • Quickly edit SKUs and product data
  • Bulk change product visibility and featured products
  • Update shipping and tax settings for multiple products
  • Optimize product titles for SEO in bulk
  • Manage large WooCommerce catalogs efficiently
  • Replace slow CSV import/export workflows

💡 Why Choose PB Bulk Product Editor?

Many WooCommerce bulk editing plugins are either too complex or rely heavily on CSV import/export.

PB Bulk Product Editor for WooCommerce is designed for:

  • Speed – Edit products instantly
  • Simplicity – Clean and intuitive UI
  • Performance – Lightweight and fast
  • Reliability – Uses WooCommerce standard methods
  • Security – Built with WordPress best practices

If you’re looking for the best WooCommerce bulk edit plugin, this tool is built to simplify your workflow and save hours of manual work.

🤝 Compatibility & Requirements

  • Requires PHP: 7.4 or higher
  • Requires WordPress: 5.8 or higher
  • Requires WooCommerce: 5.0 or higher
  • Fully compatible with the latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce

Authored with ❤️ by PluginBrew. Transform the way you manage WooCommerce today!
